links.source_location: artists.html inline <style> comments on .ar-field > span / .ar-field > input
comment: deliberately the same answer whether or not that address has an account
two independent email-capture surfaces with different consent semantics and no shared module
both resolve the same tension — erase the person, keep the non-identifying or legally-required record
both track whether a track's rights are settled, from the artist side and the owner side, with separate state vocabularies
submissions@ and artists@ are the human channels behind the submission portal
free unlimited full-track preview without an account is the stated justification
dashboard .up-* block mirrors the artists.html .ar-* upload/declaration block with no shared stylesheet or module
comment: same form the modal uses, minus the modal — reset.html re-implements the auth modal's reset form standalone
tier names and term multipliers are the pricing table the licence chooser must implement
same 'someone else has a say in commercial use' rule, stated to the artist on upload and to the buyer in the licence terms
salted stretched password hash and reset-only email are the same account record
the play/page counting the policy describes is what mutra-track.js sends
the 'buy the wider tier and we credit what you paid' rule is stated independently in both documents with no cross-reference at that point
dashboard submissions panel is ported from review.html and renders artist declarations
